subject: Entitlement onboarding & AWS Marketplace metering — clarification and next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlement onboarding & AWS Marketplace metering — clarification and next steps

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the sync last week. Per our conversation, I'm outlining the minimal steps we need to complete to get your product live on AWS Marketplace with correct entitlement mapping and metering integration. High level:

1) Confirm entitlement key in your account (customer_identifier) and how it maps to ACME internal seat/licensing IDs
2) Wire the SaaS contract (attached: SaaS_Contract_ACME_v3.docx) and sign via DocuSign
3) Provide sandbox metering webhook endpoint + example events so we can validate mapping and timestamp granularity
4) Agree on billing cadence and invoice fields (we'll accept AWS settlement, but need an internal invoice matrix)

Attached a suggested usage_schema_v2.json that shows the payload fields Redwood expects for marketplace metering events (usage dimensions and customer_id mapping). Please review and send a quick note on any fields you cannot provide.

Can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether procurement@acmeanalytics.com should be on future threads? If you can provide a sandbox endpoint this week we can run a short end-to-end test before DocuSign is executed.

Thanks — I CC'd Marcus (technical lead) so he can scope the validation work. Naomi from finance will join once the contract/settlement mapping is finalized.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: SaaS_Contract_ACME_v3.docx)
(attachment: usage_schema_v2.json)

From: Sam Green <sam.green@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Entitlement onboarding & AWS Marketplace metering — clarification and next steps

Tessa — thanks for the clear checklist. A few quick clarifications from procurement/billing side:

- Procurement timeline: we have an internal review window of 10 business days once DocuSign is received. Procurement will need to validate refund/termination language (we'll share redlines if any).
- Sandbox endpoint: we'll stand up a test webhook at https://sandbox.acmeanalytics.com/rdw-metering for you by end of day Wednesday. Will that work?
- Usage dimensionality: we can provide customer_id, product_sku, units_consumed, and iso_timestamp. We may not be able to supply a separate "feature_flag" dimension in the initial pass.

Also attaching a draft invoice matrix that finance uses to map Marketplace settlement fields into our AR system — is Redwood able to accept invoices that include the AWS settlement reference number?

On a related note, procurement asked if Redwood can support invoice PDF + machine-readable CSV for faster reconciliations. We'll attach their requested schema.

Sam
VP, Partnerships
Acme Analytics
(attachment: acme_invoice_matrix.csv)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement onboarding & AWS Marketplace metering — clarification and next steps

Sam — appreciate the fast turnaround. Confirming items and next actions below.

Procurement/Contracts
- DocuSign: we will send the DocuSign link by EOD Tuesday once you confirm no material redlines. Link will include the contract and the Marketplace addendum. (Related link: https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/?s=ABC123def456)
- Refund/termination language: Naomi will review any redlines; please route proposed edits to procurement@acmeanalytics.com and copy Naomi so she can triage financial impacts.

Metering/webhook
- Sandbox endpoint good. We'll push 50 synthetic events from our validation runner once endpoint is reachable. Expected event schema (from usage_schema_v2.json) — example:

{
  "customer_id": "acct_0a1b2c",
  "product_sku": "acme-basic-1",
  "units": 123,
  "timestamp": "2027-06-01T16:00:00Z",
  "invoice_reference": "aws-settlement-202706"
}

Notes:
- Redwood requires stable iso_timestamp and a unique event id per usage event for deduplication.
- If you cannot provide separate feature_flag today that's OK; we'll map at product_sku granularity and iterate.

Billing/reconciliation
- We do accept AWS settlement reference numbers; CSV + PDF is preferred. Naomi: can you confirm acceptable column names?

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- Acme: enable sandbox endpoint + share basic sample events (by Wed 2 Jun)
- Redwood (Marcus): run validation, report mapping gaps (by Thu 3 Jun)
- Acme: sign DocuSign (procurement window 10 business days)
- Redwood (Naomi): finalize invoice mapping and provide sample settlement reconciliation template

Marcus will take the lead on the validation plan. I'll open a shared Google Sheet for the mapping and drop in links.

Thanks —
Tessa

From: Sam Green <sam.green@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Entitlement onboarding & AWS Marketplace metering — clarification and next steps

Tessa/Marcus — quick update from our side:

- Sandbox endpoint is live: https://sandbox.acmeanalytics.com/rdw-metering. We pushed three sample events (IDs: evt_981, evt_982, evt_983) at 16:20 ET.
- Procurement: procurement@acmeanalytics.com will start review of DocuSign when link arrives. They asked for a sample reconciliation file showing AWS settlement id mapped to invoice lines — attached.
- A couple of technical notes: our sandbox will send events over TLS only and supports mutual TLS if you want stronger authentication. If Redwood prefers mTLS we can provide cert rotation details.

Next asks for Redwood before we sign:
- Can your validation runner deduplicate on event id (we will send unique event ids)?
- Will Redwood accept a single-day batching delta (i.e., we may aggregate consumption daily and send a delta each midnight UTC)?

If both are OK, procurement expects to move the contract through within the 10-business-day window. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk Marcus through the webhook and certs.

Thanks —
Sam
